_comment: The software this branch needs on the Noticeboard Server, besides the packages npm installs. Keep it up to date on every branch: when a change needs new software, or a newer version of something listed, update this file in the same commit. Before switching branch, the admin panel checks the Server against the target branch's list (Settings → Software updates). versions: space-separated conditions must all hold; || separates alternatives; * means any version.

installer._comment: Updates can't change what only the installer sets up: kiosk scripts, system services, desktop shortcuts and system packages. When install.sh changes any of those, raise version here and INSTALLER_VERSION in install.sh to the same number (in the same commit), and add a line to changes saying what running it again brings. displays: true when Clients need it too. A Server whose last installer run is older warns on the admin home page, and before switching to this branch.

changes.change: The full-screen kiosk only for the slideshow, in a browser of its own, with an exit button
A Noticeboard Help shortcut on the desktop, and the viewer hiding the mouse cursor by itself (unclutter is no longer used)
Background audio: the full-screen kiosk may play sound without anyone clicking first

software.name: Node.js
software.neededFor: Running the Noticeboard server. Some of its modules only load on Node.js 20.19 or newer (or 22.12 or newer).
software.install: Run the Noticeboard installer again: it installs Node.js 20 when the installed version is too old.

software.name: npm
software.neededFor: Installing the Noticeboard's packages when it updates.
software.install: It comes with Node.js: run the Noticeboard installer again.

software.name: FFprobe
software.neededFor: Reading the length of uploaded videos.
software.install: sudo apt install ffmpeg (FFprobe comes with it)

software.name: Chromium
software.neededFor: Showing the slideshow full screen on the Server's own screen.
software.install: sudo apt install chromium (on older Raspberry Pi OS: chromium-browser)
